accepted_exclusions.description: What the seller can enforce. See below

activation_route.description: Where the audience is matched. Core terms: `seller_side` (the seller's systems) | `clean_room` (a clean room) | `id_partner` (a third-party identity provider)

addressable_scale.description: What the line item can reach, recomputed against the buyer's selection. Not segment size. See below

agreement.description: The master or annual agreement the line item is priced under. An informative pointer; the agreement itself is outside this specification. A buyer-held agreement id travels as an `external_references[]` entry with `reference_type: agreement`

approval.description: Review SLA and revision policy, in prose

assets.description: A record of the creative that reaches the seller or that the seller builds

availability.description: What the seller says it can deliver, recomputed against the buyer's selection (§ 3.3). See below

billing.description: Who delivers is not always who invoices

break_position.description: Where in the content stream an ad plays, on `video`, `ctv`, and `audio` line items. See 5.2.3. Absent, or nothing in effect: the seller promises no position

cancellation_policy.description: See § 5.6.6. Absent: this field states no right to cancel, and `terms_refs[]` (§ 5.8) may state one

channel.description: Core terms in § 5.1.1. The discriminator for how the rest of the line item is read

commitment_bounds.description: The envelope inside which a buyer may commit, and a buyer MAY request another. See 5.6.1

committed_metrics.description: `CommittedMetric` tuples (§ 5.7.1). Seller declares its offered `level`. A buyer MAY request a stricter `level`, one further in `direction`. A request MUST NOT change a tuple's `direction`

controlling_measurement.description: Whose count of billable units is invoiced. See § 5.7.1. `max_select: 1`. `included[]` MUST name exactly one option

creative_delivery.description: How creative travels. See the creative path below. Absent: this line item states no path, and a `materials_due` still applies

creative_policy.description: Content and category restrictions on creative, in prose

daypart.description: `allowed[]` of `ClockWindow` (below). A window covers any window inside it

deal_origin.description: Absent otherwise. The advertising system domain whose namespace holds the deal ID and that pushes the deal, as the Deals API 1.0 `origin`: typically an SSP, or the ad server for a deal it books itself

delivery_counting.description: How the line item counts plays and, when it counts impressions, turns them into impressions. See 5.6.4

device.description: `allowed[]` of AdCOM 1.0 List: Device Types codes, the values of OpenRTB 2.6 `device.devicetype`. It narrows `environments` (§ 5.2.1). Mobile/Tablet - General (1) covers Phone (4) and Tablet (5)

eligible_buyers.description: The buyers that may commit, by `buyer.domain`

eligible_seats.description: The seats that may commit. An entry with an absent or empty `ids[]` names no seat and admits no one, unlike an absent OpenRTB 2.6 `Deal.wseat`, which sets no restriction

environments.description: The distribution channels and device types the line item runs on. See 5.2.1. Absent: the seller promises no environment

episodes.description: `new` | `catalog` | `all`. `new`: released within the flight. `catalog`: released before it. `all`: either

exclusions.description: The buyer's block lists, keyed by exclusion type. See below

exclusivity.description: See § 5.6.7. Nothing in effect: no exclusivity

external_references.description: The ids other systems hold for this line item. The party that learns an id writes the entry. Once the deal exists in `deal_origin`, the seller MUST record its ID as one `deal` entry on the line item. An entry is not a term and MAY be added after `agreed`

formats.description: Format ids, such as `display/300x250` and `audio/host-read-30s`. Absent: this line item states no format

geo.description: Where the line item runs. `allowed[]` of `GeoCode` (below). A line item MUST NOT declare both `geo` and `markets`

hold.description: The buyer's hold. Absent until the buyer first asks. See 5.6.2

hold_terms.description: Offers a hold. Absent means `available` is `false`. See 5.6.2

markets.description: For a line item priced by market. See `GeoCode` below

materials_due.description: Deadline for creative to reach the seller. A buyer MAY request a later date

measurement_source.description: Lets a buyer choose the measurement provider it transacts on. See § 5.7.1. Nothing in effect: no provider

placement.description: What every impression of this line item is: rewarded, interstitial, video placement subtype, skippability, playback, API frameworks, refresh, server-side insertion and audio feed. See 5.2.2

preemption.description: See § 5.6.7. Absent: no later sale preempts this line item

production.description: Custom units. See `ProductionOption` below. Nothing in effect: no custom unit

programs.description: The content the line item serves within. See 5.2.9. Absent, or nothing in effect: no content is promised

properties.description: What the line item runs on. See 5.2.4. Absent: the seller promises no property

renewal_right.description: The current advertiser's right to the next cycle. Core term: `first_refusal`, the right to buy the next cycle before it opens up. Absent: no such right. It is not a place in a hold queue (`hold.position`)

reporting.description: See § 5.7.1. Nothing in effect: no report is promised

required_credentials.description: What a buyer holds to be eligible

retention.description: From release or air. The ad stays in every copy of the content the seller distributes for at least `min` and is removed by `max`. No `max`: indefinitely. When `placement.feed` is present, only copies in that feed count toward delivery

serving_mode.description: How the ad reaches the content or the player. Core terms: `dai` | `scheduled` | `embedded`, defined below. `placement.ssai` states server-side insertion

serving_platform.description: The ad platform that serves the line item, such as the seller's ad server, by its domain. For a deal sold through a separate SSP it differs from `deal_origin`

shortfall_remedy.description: Core terms: `makegood` | `credit` | `none`. See `remedy_terms` in § 5.7.1. Nothing in effect: this line item states no remedy. Its committed levels stay guaranteed, because only `none` makes them targets

sov_basis.description: `impressions` | `loop_time`. `impressions`: a share of the line item's eligible impressions (digital placements, pooled DOOH products). `loop_time`: a share of each named screen's loop time (fixed-loop DOOH spots)

sov_share.description: Absent under `loop_time`. The promised share, greater than 0

status.description: Independent of the proposal's status, so one line item may sell out while the rest of the shelf stays live

terms_refs.description: The binding documents of this line item, such as a main agreement and its addenda, or an IO template. Every entry applies, with no AND or OR. A `commitment` entry accepts them all (§ 4.1.2). Absent: a `commitment` entry accepts no document

time_zone.description: The clock for `daypart` and a calendar `frequency_cap.period`

transaction_mechanism.description: The mechanisms the seller offers. A seller MAY offer the same inventory through more than one. `max_select: 1`
